full_prompt_en: The image is a square tattoo-art-like illustration of an ornamented skull framed by roses and a golden radiating ring. A frontal pale skull fills the center, its dark eye sockets and triangular nasal opening forming strong black shapes. The teeth remain individually drawn in a tight ivory row. Across the forehead, cheekbones, and jaw, turquoise, coral, pink, gold, and black ornamental patterns overlap the bone color. A pink eye-like radiating emblem sits high on the forehead, while smaller curls, dots, and flower-like marks spread down toward the mouth. Behind the upper skull, a broad golden circle arches from left to right, interrupted by short hot-pink rays that project outward. Deep black surrounds the ring, scattered with tiny stars and patterned fragments. Large pink roses press against both sides of the skull, one at the upper left and another at the lower right. Along the lower edge, orange and yellow daisy-like flowers, dark teal leaves, and small red blooms build a dense base. A narrow dark rectangular border contains the whole arrangement. The composition is nearly symmetrical around the skull but deliberately offset by the different flower sizes and placements. Graphic light is even: the pale skull and yellow ring appear bright against deep black, while the colored floral masses remain saturated rather than naturally shaded. Heavy outlines and small etched details sharpen the anatomy and petals; slight grain and layered texture keep the surface from looking flat. The whole image is packed from edge to edge, balancing a central bone-white structure with lush hot-color ornament and dark negative pockets.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、带纹身艺术气息的插画：一颗带纹饰的骷髅被玫瑰与金色放射圆环围住。正面的浅色骷髅填在中央，暗眼窝和三角鼻洞形成有力黑形。牙齿仍被一颗颗紧密画在象牙色横列中。前额、颧骨与下颌上，青绿、珊瑚、粉、金与黑色装饰纹样盖过骨色。前额高处有粉色眼形放射徽记，较小的卷线、圆点和花状痕迹向嘴边散开。头骨上方后面，一道宽金圆从左拱到右，被向外突出的短热粉色光芒打断。圆环四周是深黑底，散着小星点和花纹碎片。大粉玫瑰挤着骷髅两侧，一朵在左上，一朵在右下。下缘，橙黄雏菊状花、深青叶和小红花搭出密实底座。一道窄暗矩形框住整个布局。构图围绕骷髅近乎对称，但大小与位置各异的花有意打破严格平衡。图形化光线均匀：浅骷髅与黄圆环在深黑前显亮，有色花团保持饱和，而非自然明暗。粗轮廓与细刻纹使骨骼和花瓣清晰，轻颗粒与层叠纹理又避免表面平板。整幅从边到边塞满，让中央骨白结构与丰茂热色装饰、暗留口保持平衡。
style_prompt_en: Tattoo-art-like illustration packs a central pale structure inside a dark rectangular field of dense ornament. Heavy black contours and deep voids are offset by saturated magenta, coral, turquoise, gold, and orange. A broad luminous ring and short radial spikes organize the upper area, while repeated curling and petal-like motifs accumulate around the sides and base. Tiny glints, dots, and etched lines provide close detail between the larger shapes. Light is primarily graphic contrast: ivory and gold glow against black without a realistic cast-shadow system. Slight grain and layered printlike texture soften the otherwise crisp edges. The arrangement is nearly symmetrical but loosened by unequal clusters, creating intense, decorative, edge-to-edge energy.
style_prompt_zh: 纹身艺术式插画把中央浅色结构塞进暗色矩形场的密集装饰中。粗黑轮廓和深暗洞与饱和洋红、珊瑚、青绿、金和橙色相对。宽阔发光圆环与短放射尖刺组织上方，重复卷线和瓣状纹样积在两侧与底部。小亮点、圆点与刻线在大形之间提供近处细节。光主要是图形对比：象牙色与金色在黑底前发亮，没有写实投影系统。轻颗粒和层叠印刷般纹理柔化原本清脆的边缘。布局近乎对称，又被大小不等的聚团松开，形成强烈装饰性、从边到边的能量。
theme_en: An ornamented skull framed by roses and a golden radiating ring
theme_zh: 一颗带纹饰的骷髅被玫瑰与金色放射圆环围住
name: Ed Hardy
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
